stemMd: A fund will finance a project only if the project has independent oversight. A project with independent oversight and a demonstrated public benefit must receive financing unless its cost exceeds the annual cap. Which case is definitely entitled to financing?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A project with oversight but no demonstrated public benefit.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A beneficial project with oversight whose cost exceeds the cap.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A project with public benefit and low cost but no independent oversight.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A project with independent oversight, demonstrated public benefit, and cost equal to the annual cap.

options.label: E
options.textMd: A low-cost project with no information about oversight.

explanationMd: Apply all sufficient conditions and then check the exception. Equal to the cap does not exceed it, so the qualifying project must be financed. The other cases either fail a requirement or fall within the exception.

distractorRationale.e: Low cost cannot substitute for the required oversight.
